question: Which famous book was written by ‘Haripala’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangeeta Sudhakara**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangeeta Sudhakara** is a famous book written by Haripala.
 
• Haripala is known for his contributions to the field of music and his work, **Sangeeta Sudhakara**, is a significant text in Indian classical music literature.
 
• The book provides insights into the musical traditions and practices of the time and is considered an important source for the study of Indian music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gita Govinda** is a 12th-century work composed by the poet Jayadeva, not Haripala.
 
• **Sangeet Ratnakara** was written by Sharngadeva in the 13th century and is another significant text in Indian music.
 
• **Sangeet Darpan** is also a notable work in the field of music, but it was not authored by Haripala.
